stem: An 8-year-old says there is something moving in the ear after camping, and otoscopy shows a live insect; what should be done first?

options.text: Instil sesame or olive oil to kill the insect
Pass a hook blindly into the canal

explanation: Instil sesame or olive oil to kill the insect first. This is the initial step for a live insect in the external ear canal before attempting removal.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because instilling sesame or olive oil kills or immobilises the live insect first, making removal safer.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because immediate irrigation is not the first step for a live insect and may be inappropriate if the tympanic membrane is not intact.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because a hook should not be passed blindly into the canal; removal should only be attempted under direct vision.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because observation does not address the live insect and is not the recommended first action.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because oral antibiotics do not treat the insect and are not the initial management step.
